title: Refined-product stress becomes a multi-channel conditional state
summary: China's October refined-product export suspension adds an independent supply-security withdrawal channel to Russian policy risk and Middle-East disruption. The combined regime is materially tighter, but policy/source reports do not prove sustained physical shortage, realized export suppression, directional alpha, or trading authority.
net_new_delta: GLOBAL_REFINED_PRODUCT_STRESS_NOW_REQUIRES_A_MULTI_PRODUCER_CONDITIONAL_STATE_MACHINE: CHINA_EXPORT_WITHDRAWAL + RUSSIA_MULTI_CONDITION_RESTRICTION + MIDDLE_EAST_FLOW_IMPAIRMENT + G7_POLICY_BUFFER MUST REMAIN DISTINCT, TIMESTAMPED, AND PROMOTED ONLY BY VERIFIED PERMISSIONS, LOADINGS, INVENTORIES, CRACKS, AND PHYSICAL FLOWS.
accepted_findings: MACRO: Chinese refiners suspended October product exports beyond Hong Kong and Macau; reported domestic diesel/gasoil and gasoline inventory deficits support a time-valid CHINA_REFINED_PRODUCT_EXPORT_WITHDRAWAL state.
MACRO/AION lineage: Russian diesel restriction risk is conditional on both sanctions policy and domestic overproduction relief, not a mechanical end-October expiry.
CONTROL PLANE: restored-five Flow 06:35Z has an exact canonical native receipt; GitHub-native v3 persisted Flow 06:24Z after the watchdog miss, correctly classifying it as MISSED_THEN_LATE_NATIVE.
rejected_findings: Reject China's suspension as a permanent export ban or quantified global shortage before post-October-7 permissions and cargo loadings are verified.
Reject aggregation of China, Russia, and Middle-East stress into one undifferentiated directional signal.
Reject current GitHub-native v3 receipts as substantive specialist inference because they explicitly retain deterministic_liveness and SUBSTANTIVE_AI_INFERENCE_NOT_EXECUTED.
Reject watchdog durability, newer RUN_IDs, or late receipts as retroactive proof of on-time native execution or scientific authority.
conflicts: China's withdrawal may reverse after the holiday if inventories/refining output recover, and South Korea or India may partially substitute supply.
The G7/IEA emergency product buffer can cushion stress but does not establish realized physical normalization.
Restored-five health is heterogeneous: Flow is exact-slot verified, Apex is missing for 06:45Z, and Alpha 06:25Z remains watchdog durability only.
At 06:54Z the v3 watchdog marked AION 06:36Z and Flow 06:24Z missing; the subsequent v3 run persisted Flow 06:24Z but emitted prior-hour AION/DAEDALUS slots, leaving current-slot completeness uneven.
blockers: Post-October-7 Chinese export permissions and actual diesel/gasoline/jet-fuel loadings are unverified.
Cross-producer substitution volumes, domestic inventories, Asian diesel cracks/spreads, and realized global product flows remain incomplete.
No frozen event population, multiplicity control, protected temporal OOS, transaction-cost-valid rule, or execution authority exists.
Current AION/DAEDALUS v3 substantive inference remains absent; some current control-plane slots are late, missing, or watchdog-only.
next_highest_value_integration_target: JANUS and ATHENA should implement a producer-resolved refined-product transition lattice: POLICY_OR_INVENTORY_TRIGGER -> EXPORT_PERMISSION_OR_RESTRICTION -> CARGO_LOADING -> REGIONAL_SUBSTITUTION -> INVENTORY_AND_CRACK_RESPONSE -> VERIFIED_PHYSICAL_STRESS_OR_RELIEF. Keep China, Russia, Middle East, and G7 buffer branches separate, then integrate only at the verified physical-flow layer.

owner_job_status_dependencies.dependency: Post-Oct-7 China permissions, loadings, substitution and inventory evidence
Timestamped producer-specific state branches and non-overwriting transition history
Consecutive exact-slot native receipts; resolve Apex/Alpha and current AION/DAEDALUS gaps

athena.finding: Model refined-product stress as branching producer-specific uncertainty; China adds an independent withdrawal state, but duration and global impact require physical confirmation.

janus.finding: Preserve China, Russia, Middle-East and G7-buffer states independently and reconcile them only through verified permission, loading, substitution, inventory and crack transitions.

infrastructure.finding: Flow 06:35Z is exact-slot native verified and v3 Flow 06:24Z reconciled late; Apex 06:45Z is missing, Alpha 06:25Z is watchdog-only, and current AION/DAEDALUS completeness remains uneven.

helios_prime.finding: Integrate the multi-channel product-stress model while preserving strict separation among source/policy evidence, physical-flow evidence, scientific evidence, and liveness provenance.
